## Bump the AI SDK to 7.0.161

**Why.** The 7.0.161 release fixes tool-call delta order when two tools stream in parallel, which Nimbus does when the Orchestrator spawns agents. No API changes.

**Change.** `ai` ^7.0.154 → ^7.0.161 in package.json.

**Check.** `git apply --check` passes and the tree typechecks.
